title: Vertiv establishes Washington, D.C. presence to advance U.S. AI infrastructure leadership
summary: Vertiv (NYSE: VRT), a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, today announced the creation of a new government relations function and the opening of its Washington, D.C. presence with the appointment of Erica Thomas as director of government relations. This new function reflects Vertiv’s commitment to engaging more directly with policymakers at a time when U.S. leadership in artificial intelligence (AI) is a national priority.
